item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Interactions of Representation Theory and Topology (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-02 Algebra e geometria

Bazier-Matte and Schiffler developed a new categorification of the Alexander polynomial of a knot through quivers with potential and cluster algebras. The construction associates to a knot a quiver with potential and some of its representations. The aim of this project is to generalize the construction to the case of arbitrary planar graphs.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-02-mate - Normal functions, second fundamental form, correspond-ences, and lagrangian variety in algebraic geometry (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-02 Algebra e geometria

The goal is to study some problems in complex algebraic geometry using the methods of Hodge theory. Specifically, we will deepen results on the rank of normal functions, im-prove the bounds of the second fundamental form for sub-varieties of the moduli space of Abelian varieties, study correspondeces and construct new Lagrangian surfaces on Abelian varieties.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Optimising Electric Vehicle Operations in Logistics Applications - 2026_IDR_DEIB_64 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-06 Ricerca operativa

The candidate will develop mathematical models and algorithms aimed at optimizing the operations of electric commercial vehicles within a large warehouse. The considered activities are charge scheduling, transportation, loading and unloading. Furthermore, the candidate will embed the resulting algorithms within a simulation tool, which is to be interfaced with existing software systems.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Computational prediction of arrhythmogenesis - 2026_IDR_DCMC_23 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-05 Analisi numerica

Numerical simulation of action potential propagation in cardiac electrophysiology is currently a highly useful tool for predictive purposes. This project builds upon the work carried out within the INNOVA project regarding arrhythmia prediction. Specifically, it aims to validate proposed risk indices and evaluate the importance of including myocardial motion and the right ventricle in the simulations. The LifeX finite element library will be used for these purposes.

Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-02 Algebra e geometria

The project aims to study real convex projective manifolds equipped with the so called Hilbert metric. One of the main leading problems in the fields is the understanding of relationships between invariants as Euler characteristic and simplicial volume. These research line naturally generalises in many directions as the study of bounded cohomology of groups and manifolds.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Models for Suspension Bridges and their interaction with fluids - 2026_IDR_DMAT_12 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-03 Analisi matematica, probabilità e statistica matematica

Suspension bridges are subject to aerodynamic forces. Both the structural behaviour of bridges and the vortex shedding in the wind flow are extremely difficult to model. The research program should suggest new theoretical models able to highlight some hidden phenomena such as possible nonuniqueness of solutions of the coupled fluid-structure interaction system, as well as their long-time behaviour. A first step could be to consider a scalar version of the Navier-Stokes equations. The knowledge of specific tools in PDEs and functional analysis appear necessary.
